name: Blinn-Phong Shading Model
definition: Computes specular reflectance using the Blinn-Phong approximation with a cosine-power lobe.
summary: The Blinn-Phong Shading Model is a local illumination model for volume visualization that calculates emitted color using ambient, diffuse, and specular components, distinguished by using the half-vector for specular calculation instead of the reflected light vector.
